# EncodeAll

> Free online hash, encoding, decoding, formatting and developer tools. Every tool runs locally in the browser; input is never uploaded.

## Tools

- [Base32 Decode](https://encodeall.github.io/base32_decode.html): This Base32 decode online tool helps you decode Base32 string to original text. Free, fast and private: runs in your browser.
- [Decode Base32 to File](https://encodeall.github.io/base32_decode_file.html): This Base32 to file online tool helps you decode Base32 string to file and download. Free, fast and private: runs in your browser.
- [Base32 Encode](https://encodeall.github.io/base32_encode.html): This Base32 encode online tool helps you encode text or binary to Base32. You can input UTF-8, UTF-16, Hex to Base32. Free, fast and private: runs in your browser.
- [Encode File to Base32](https://encodeall.github.io/base32_encode_file.html): This file to Base32 online tool helps you encode local or remote file to Base32 string to without uploading file. Free, fast and private: runs in your browser.
- [Base58 Decode](https://encodeall.github.io/base58_decode.html): This Base58 decode online tool helps you decode Base58 string to original text. Free, fast and private: runs in your browser.
- [Decode Base58 to File](https://encodeall.github.io/base58_decode_file.html): This Base58 to file online tool helps you decode Base58 string to file and download. Free, fast and private: runs in your browser.
- [Base58 Encode](https://encodeall.github.io/base58_encode.html): This Base58 encode online tool helps you encode text or binary to Base58. You can input UTF-8, UTF-16, Hex to Base58. Free, fast and private: runs in your browser.
- [Encode File to Base58](https://encodeall.github.io/base58_encode_file.html): This file to Base58 online tool helps you encode local or remote file to Base58 string to without uploading file. Free, fast and private: runs in your browser.
- [Base64 Decode](https://encodeall.github.io/base64_decode.html): This Base64 decode online tool helps you decode Base64 string to original text. Free, fast and private: runs in your browser.
- [Decode Base64 to File](https://encodeall.github.io/base64_decode_file.html): This Base64 to file online tool helps you decode Base64 string to file and download. Free, fast and private: runs in your browser.
- [Base64 Encode](https://encodeall.github.io/base64_encode.html): This Base64 encode online tool helps you encode text or binary to Base64. You can input UTF-8, UTF-16, Hex to Base64. Free, fast and private: runs in your browser.
- [Encode File to Base64](https://encodeall.github.io/base64_encode_file.html): This file to Base64 online tool helps you encode local or remote file to Base64 string to without uploading file. Free, fast and private: runs in your browser.
- [BLAKE2b](https://encodeall.github.io/blake2b/): This BLAKE2b online tool helps you calculate hashes from strings. You can input UTF-8, UTF-16, Hex, Base64, or other encodings.
- [BLAKE2b File Hash](https://encodeall.github.io/blake2b/file/): This BLAKE2b online tool helps you calculate the hash of a file from local or URL using BLAKE2b without uploading the file.
- [BLAKE2s](https://encodeall.github.io/blake2s/): This BLAKE2s online tool helps you calculate hashes from strings. You can input UTF-8, UTF-16, Hex, Base64, or other encodings.
- [BLAKE2s File Hash](https://encodeall.github.io/blake2s/file/): This BLAKE2s online tool helps you calculate the hash of a file from local or URL using BLAKE2b without uploading the file.

- [BLAKE3 File Hash](https://encodeall.github.io/blake3/file/): This BLAKE3 online tool helps you calculate the hash of a file from local or URL using BLAKE2b without uploading the file.
- [Constant Case Converter](https://encodeall.github.io/convert_constant_case.html): Convert string to constant case. (Screaming snake case, MACRO_CASE) Free, fast and private: runs in your browser.
- [Kebab Case Converter](https://encodeall.github.io/convert_kebab_case.html): Convert string to kebab case. (Dash case, Lisp case, Spinal case) Free, fast and private: runs in your browser.
- [Lower Camel Case Converter](https://encodeall.github.io/convert_lower_camel_case.html): Convert string to lower camel case (Dromedary case). Free, fast and private: runs in your browser.
- [Lower Case Converter](https://encodeall.github.io/convert_lower_case.html): Convert string to lower case. (Downcase) Free, fast and private: runs in your browser.
- [Snake Case Converter](https://encodeall.github.io/convert_snake_case.html): Convert string to snake case. (Snail case, Pothole case) Free, fast and private: runs in your browser.
- [Upper Camel Case Converter](https://encodeall.github.io/convert_upper_camel_case.html): Convert string to upper camel case (Pascal case). Free, fast and private: runs in your browser.
- [Upper Case Converter](https://encodeall.github.io/convert_upper_case.html): Convert string to upper case. (Upcase, All caps) Free, fast and private: runs in your browser.
